lessons.keep: Keep each request visibly matched to a distinct output type.
lessons.avoid: Treating a gallery of polished outputs as a complete account of how users finish their work.
lessons.open: Artifact accuracy, sources, export behavior, revision controls, generation time and audio remain unverified.
